correctness.rationale: Carry conservation s_2(n+t)-s_2(n)=k-C identifies the nondecrease event as C<=k. If a carry enters an inter-one zero run, its first incoming carry already contributed at least one to C; after k zero digits any continuing carry would exceed the budget. Longer runs therefore cannot change retained probabilities, proving d_i -> min(d_i,k+1) for all k and finite bound t<2^(k^2). Exact two-state carry updates and geometric tail give common denominator 2^(k^2+k+1). Independently implemented Fraction recursion and an unrelated C++17 128-bit exhaustive canonical-gap enumerator; all 5,063,361 tuples k=1..8 reproduced every minimum and complete odd optimizer list (1;5;11,13;27;107;219;439,475;951), with no optimizer at a clipping boundary. This verifies all-weight lemma plus finite exact table, not any larger-k table.
